source.howDecided: The product side is the correct, deliberate behavior, so 'unchanged' here means the 404 is still what the documented address produces. git log 038381aeca..origin/main over apps/web/server/lib/[user]/[type]/getServerSideProps.ts returns nothing, and the file is still 319 lines with getUserPageProps at 212, the params parse at 214, the getPublicEvent call at 245-253 keyed on eventSlug: slug (248), and the two notFound returns at 237 and 257. There is still no [user]/book route: nothing in the four commits since the tested one touches apps/web/app or next.config.ts. So /{user}/book still resolves as [user]/[type] with slug 'book', matches no event type, and 404s, exactly as issue #6612 intended when the route was retired in 2023.

reevaluation: The finding stands and is now confirmed on the live help centre, not only in the repo. The product side is unchanged and correct: no [user]/book route exists at today's head, so the printed address still 404s, deliberately, per #6612. The doc side is unchanged in all three places: calcom/help bookings/prefill-fields.mdx line 20 on main (path untouched since 2025-11-17), the calcom/docs mirror line 19 (untouched since 2024-02-15), and the served page at https://cal.com/help/bookings/prefill-fields, which returned 200 today and still prints the URL. No tracker item proposes fixing it. Nothing changes the verdict (doc-bug, high confidence). One correction of emphasis for the filer rather than of fact: the review is right that fixing the path alone is not enough, because type=12345 and duration=30 are inert old-booker parameters on the current booker, so a correct example is closer to https://cal.com/johndoe/30min?email=johndoe%40example.com&notes=Test+Notes.
policyBasis: calcom/help has issues enabled (has_issues=true) but is overwhelmingly PR-driven: it has only 3 open non-PR issues (#1 and #2 from March 2025, #126 from April 2026) against 40 open items, and every recent item (#153 to #158, July 2026) is a docs PR. There is no ISSUE_TEMPLATE and no CONTRIBUTING in the repo (only .github/workflows), so nothing constrains the report's shape.
notes: Given calcom/help's practice, a one-line PR against bookings/prefill-fields.mdx will land far faster than an issue; treat 'docs repo issue' as the fallback if a PR is out of scope for this filing round, and say in either that the identical line exists in the calcom/docs mirror (pages/core-features/bookings/prefill-fields.mdoc line 19) so both need the edit. The fix is not a path swap: type=12345 and duration=30 are old-booker parameters that do nothing on the current booker, so propose https://cal.com/johndoe/30min?email=johndoe%40example.com&notes=Test+Notes and point at the sibling page calcom/docs legacy/pages/developer/pre-fill.mdx, which already uses the correct modern shape. Worth including the hazard #6612 itself raised: because 'book' is now an ordinary event-type slug, a host who owns an event type slugged 'book' turns the stale URL into a plausible wrong page with the prefill applied rather than an honest 404.
